description: Asks two independent public DNS resolvers (AdGuard DNS and NextDNS) for the same name and record type right now and reports whether they agree, with each answer set and its lowest TTL. It shows cache and geo-DNS differences between resolvers; it is two vantage points, not a worldwide propagation survey. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

name.description: Host or domain name, e.g. example.com (required)

type.description: A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT or CNAME (default A)

name: security_dns_propagation
title: Security Dns Propagation
